description: Securely read from and save to authorized workspace directories.

list_directory.description: List the contents of a directory in the workspace.

path.description: Single path to list. Paths are automatically resolved relative to your workspace root. This tool does NOT support native batching; for multiple paths, emit multiple tool call tags.

read_file.description: Read the content of a file in the workspace.

path.description: Single path to read. Paths are automatically resolved relative to your workspace root. This tool does NOT support native batching; for multiple files, emit multiple tool call tags.

write_file.description: Save content to a persistent file in the workspace.

path.description: Single path to save. Paths are automatically resolved relative to your workspace root. This tool does NOT support native batching; for multiple files, emit multiple tool call tags.

content.description: The exact string content to save. For JSON files, this MUST be a JSON-formatted string, NOT a JSON object.

edit_file_block.description: Replace an exact block of text in an existing file. Use this to fix bugs or edit existing code without rewriting the entire file. If the block appears multiple times, include more surrounding context (3-5 lines) in old_block.

path.description: Path to the file to edit. Paths are automatically resolved relative to the workspace root.

old_block.description: The exact text to locate. Surrounding whitespace is normalized, so indentation differences are tolerated. If the block appears multiple times, include extra context lines.

append_file.description: Append content to an existing file in the workspace.

path.description: Single path to append to. The file must already exist. Paths are automatically resolved relative to your workspace root.

content.description: The content to append to the file. Use this to build large files incrementally — start with write_file and continue with append_file.
